decisions.decision: Vijay and Dipasha have decided to separate. Marriage ends after ~3 years. He reports feeling a sense of looking forward and a strong drive to make money and do well for himself.

The mutual decision happened during Rahu-Venus-Mercury pratyantar (communication catalyst).
